entry.title: When a hub is paged
entry.summary: Only a hub over its sidebar child cap is paged, and only when its children outnumber its page size.
entry.content:
A hub is paged when two things are true:

  • it has more children than its sidebar child cap, so the sidebar shows one entry for them;
  • it has more children than its page size.

Any other hub lists all its children on its own page, exactly as before.
